positiveEvidence: Coop Liguria public charging project is operated in collaboration with Nucleo - Special Concepts under Coop Power branding.

Published Coop Power host tariffs are 0.39 EUR/kWh for lower-power/approximately 100 km charging and 0.49 EUR/kWh for higher-power/approximately 750 km charging; contemporary technical coverage identifies AC up to 22 kW and DC ultrafast up to 160 kW at these Coop sites.
investigations.decision: Do not promote 0.39/0.49 EUR/kWh to all IT*CPO EVSE. The evidence establishes a deterministic Coop Power host subset, not a network-wide Nucleo tariff. Resolve IT*CPO EVSE to Coop Power locations/host and connector class before ranking.

investigations.uncoveredSubset: All other Nucleo/Special Concepts IT*CPO EVSE remain fail-closed.
investigations.blockingCondition: deterministic IT*CPO EVSE -> host/site -> direct tariff mapping, preferably QR/backend/PUN/first-party
